fusions.name: Circle and Strike
fusions.desc: Rushes 7 tiles to the target and bites for 14 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: Snaps at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage. The damage rises 8% for each affliction on the target, up to 40%. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Feeding Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fed by the Chase
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
